Democrats want to trap kids in failing systems and call it “opportunity.”

The majority of Senate Democrats, led by Senators Mark Kelly and Mazie Hirono, want to kill the Education Freedom Tax Credit—ripping away opportunity from millions of kids just to protect a broken status quo. 

I’m living proof that education opens doors. Why are Democrats so determined to slam them shut? School choice is about hope, freedom, and putting parents—not politicians—in charge.


Senator Mark Kelly (@SenMarkKel

A senseless act by an illegal immigrant took two precious lives and brought unimaginable pain to families in South Carolina. 

The hearts of South Carolinians are with them as we pray for comfort, healing, and justice.

Video

Opportunity Zones are continuing to expand across South Carolina and empower the communities that need them most. I was proud to author OZs to drive long-term private investment into economically distressed areas. State leaders are now calling for input to help direct investment into once-forgotten communities!

Under the Working Families Tax Cuts, all taxpayers are allowed to deduct charitable contributions from their taxes. While Democrats voted to block it, Republicans worked to expand this deduction for Americans who give and Americans who need our support.

Democrats have made it clear: their personal and political interests are more important than the safety and security of American families. It’s unconscionable.

Video

It’s Tax Day, and this year nearly $300 a month is going back to hardworking Americans because of the Working Families Tax Cuts. Thank a Republican!

Video
